Implementation: Refactor Like Post Handler

Summary

Refactored the like post and comment workflows in src/Action/V1/Likes/ (LikePost.go and LikeComment.go). Extracted reusable helpers for blocked user/post caching, like toggling, payload construction, token collection, and notification broadcasting into helpers.go with unit tests in helpers_test.go. The main handler line count was reduced from 361 to 157 lines with zero changes to flow or response payloads.

Files Updated

1. New Helper Module and Tests in src/Action/V1/Likes/

  • helpers.go:
    • likePostTarget: Internal model struct for querying post target information.
    • getUserBlockedFilters: Retrieves decoded blocked posts and blocked users from Redis.
    • togglePostLike: Encapsulates checking, creating, and deleting Models.Like records.
    • buildPostDataPayload: Assembles post data with unescaped HTML and short/long descriptions.
    • collectPushTokens: Fetches recipient mobile and web push tokens, chunking appropriately.
    • dispatchLikeNotification: Persists notification records and upserts broadcast containers.
  • helpers_test.go:
    • TestBuildPostDataPayload: Validates HTML entity unescaping, description truncation, and nil fields.
    • TestGetUserBlockedFiltersNilRedis: Tests safe execution when Redis client is uninitialized.

2. Refactored Handlers in src/Action/V1/Likes/

  • LikePost.go:
    • Line count reduced from 361 to 157 lines (over 55% reduction).
    • Adopted getUserBlockedFilters, togglePostLike, buildPostDataPayload, and dispatchLikeNotification.
    • Maintained exact responses (self-like rejection, like/unlike success messages, and all error branches).
  • LikeComment.go:
    • Adopted getUserBlockedFilters, eliminating 15 lines of duplicate Redis retrieval.
    • Cleaned up unused imports (context, Redis).

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Likes/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Users/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Auth/...
go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...
go build ./...
  • All 3 unit tests in src/Action/V1/Likes/ passed.
  • All test suites across the repository passed.
  • Entire repository compiled cleanly with go build ./... (0 errors).

Problem

The handler src/Action/V1/Likes/LikePost.go was a dense 361-line file containing multiple entangled steps in one function:

  1. Blocked Lists Lookup: Reading and base64 JSON decoding blocked post and user keys from Redis was repeated in both LikePost.go and LikeComment.go.
  2. Post Payload & Description Handling: HTML unescaping and description truncation logic for notifications was embedded directly in the middle of database operations.
  3. Toggle Logic: Checking, inserting, or deleting like records in database.
  4. Push Notification & Broadcast Delivery: Querying mobile and web notification tokens, chunking tokens, creating notification records, and upserting broadcast containers.

Scope

  • Create helper functions in src/Action/V1/Likes/helpers.go:
    • getUserBlockedFilters: Shared retrieval of cached blocked posts and users from Redis.
    • togglePostLike: Encapsulates like checking, creating (like), or deleting (unlike).
    • buildPostDataPayload: Assembles post payload with HTML-unescaped description and truncated previews.
    • collectPushTokens: Gathers and chunks mobile (chunk 100) and web (chunk 10) push notification tokens.
    • dispatchLikeNotification: Handles notification creation and broadcast container upsert.
  • Add unit tests in src/Action/V1/Likes/helpers_test.go:
    • TestBuildPostDataPayload: Tests payload construction, HTML unescaping, and nil field handling.
    • TestGetUserBlockedFiltersNilRedis: Tests safe retrieval when Redis client is nil.
  • Refactor LikePost.go:
    • Adopt shared helpers without modifying any business logic, database transactions, ElasticSearch counter calls, or response structures.
  • Refactor LikeComment.go:
    • Adopt getUserBlockedFilters to eliminate duplicate Redis retrieval logic.
  • Follow uppercase step comment conventions (// COMMENT) and clean function headers (// ===================================//).

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: maintains exact status codes, error messages, like/unlike action strings, ElasticSearch counter updates, and notification payloads.
  • Zero changes to response contracts for frontend clients.

Out of Scope

  • Changing notification templates, push notification providers, or database schemas.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Shared helpers created with unit test coverage.
  • Handlers in src/Action/V1/Likes/ refactored and deduplicated cleanly.
  • All unit tests pass (go test ./src/Action/V1/Likes/...).
  • Project builds cleanly (go build ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-18.

Implementation: Modularize Push Notification Handler

Summary

Modularized src/Action/V1/Notifications/PushNotification.go by extracting media sanitization, Redis blocked list retrieval, duplicate checking, and multi-channel push dispatching (Expo mobile & Web Push) into helpers.go accompanied by unit tests in helpers_test.go. The main handler was streamlined from 406 to 240 lines while strictly maintaining exact payload and response contracts.

Files Updated

1. New Helper Module and Tests in src/Action/V1/Notifications/

  • helpers.go:
    • sanitizeNotificationMedia: Sanitizes "undefined" strings and applies fallback paths/images.
    • getBlockedUsers: Retrieves decoded blocked user encrypt identifiers from Redis cache.
    • getBlockedPosts: Retrieves decoded blocked post slugs from Redis cache.
    • fetchNotificationPost: Encapsulates post querying, description unescaping and truncation, and location/quality JSON parsing.
    • checkRecipientUser: Queries recipient user in DB and checks against blocked user lists.
    • checkNotificationDuplicate: Queries database to check if the notification was already delivered.
    • broadcastMobilePush: Queries mobile push tokens, chunks into batches of 100, and triggers BroadcastFunctions.BroadcastMobile.
    • broadcastWebPush: Queries web push tokens, chunks into batches of 10, unmarshals, and triggers BroadcastFunctions.BroadcastWeb.
  • helpers_test.go:
    • TestSanitizeNotificationMedia: Tests media sanitization with valid, empty, and "undefined" inputs.
    • TestGetBlockedHelpersSafeWithoutRedis: Verifies graceful behavior when Redis client is uninitialized.

2. Refactored Handler in src/Action/V1/Notifications/

  • PushNotification.go:
    • Line count reduced from 406 to 240 lines (over 40% reduction).
    • Adopted sanitizeNotificationMedia, getBlockedUsers, getBlockedPosts, checkNotificationDuplicate, broadcastMobilePush, and broadcastWebPush.
    • Maintained exact self-notification rejection, duplicate check response, mention queue publishing, and success envelopes.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Notifications/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Likes/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Users/...
go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...
go build ./...
  • All 5 unit tests in src/Action/V1/Notifications/ passed cleanly.
  • All test suites across the repository passed.
  • Entire repository compiled cleanly with go build ./... (0 errors).

Problem

The handler src/Action/V1/Notifications/PushNotification.go was a 406-line monolithic file handling multiple tangled responsibilities:

  1. Media Placeholder Sanitization: Sanitizing "undefined" and applying fallback default URLs for paths and images was duplicated inline.
  2. Blocked Cache Queries: Manual Redis lookups for blocked users and blocked posts were mixed into the main notification flow.
  3. Notification Deduplication: Inline database count checks for duplicate notifications.
  4. Push Token Processing and Broadcasting: Fetching mobile tokens, chunking them into batches of 100, constructing Models.DataBroadcast, and dispatching to Expo; fetching web tokens, chunking into batches of 10, unmarshaling, constructing Models.BroadcastWeb, and dispatching to Web Push.

Scope

  • Create helper functions in src/Action/V1/Notifications/helpers.go:
    • sanitizeNotificationMedia: Sanitizes undefined string placeholders and applies default paths/images.
    • getBlockedUsers & getBlockedPosts: Encapsulates Redis blocked user and post lookups.
    • checkNotificationDuplicate: Encapsulates deduplication count checks.
    • broadcastMobilePush: Manages mobile push token batching (chunk 100) and Expo broadcasting.
    • broadcastWebPush: Manages web push token batching (chunk 10) and Web Push broadcasting.
  • Add unit tests in src/Action/V1/Notifications/helpers_test.go:
    • TestSanitizeNotificationMedia: Tests fallback and placeholder cleanup.
    • TestGetBlockedHelpersSafeWithoutRedis: Verifies safe execution when Redis is nil.
  • Refactor PushNotification.go:
    • Adopt shared helpers without modifying any business logic, message bodies, RabbitMQ mention triggers, database inserts, or JSON response envelopes.
  • Follow uppercase step comments (// COMMENT) and function headers (// ===================================//).

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: maintains exact status codes, error payloads, notification records, and push broadcast structures.
  • Zero changes to response contracts for frontend clients.

Out of Scope

  • Changing Expo or Web Push provider credentials or external push endpoints.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Helper module created with unit test coverage.
  • PushNotification.go refactored and streamlined.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./src/Action/V1/Notifications/...).
  • Project builds cleanly (go build ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-18.
